title: ENStable
tagline: Our team is developing a Uniswap v4 Hook that audits liquidity based on your ENS risk profile.
description: The idea has become much more concrete as we focus on Unichain L2. We are integrating ENS L2 Primary Names to define position ownership, ensuring a decentralized identity layer for our agentic vault. We are now working at full speed to meet the submission deadline and are confident in delivering a functional MVP that showcases a truly simple and secure vault controlled by an intelligent off-chain agent.
